failures.description: AgentCard production lifecycle (agent-payment-production-abandonment) refused at preflight on merge 95d5350e1: 'Production payment identity 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000107 is not provisioned: Stripe billing mode must be live (stripeLivemode=False).' The production payer fixture is Stripe test mode; a live-mode lifecycle needs a KYC cardholder only the user can provide (same cause as PR #1744/#1825). The run stopped before minting a card or placing a hold, so no live AgentCard or Stripe resource was created.
